vc_checking.summary: All 15 cleaned manual obligations are semantically provable. Fourteen return witnesses unfold CircularAreaCallResult or CircularAreaReadCallResult and preserve the exact caller resources. The repeated-write pure witness follows from the b_status=0 equivalence embedded in CircularAreaLogicalState. No annotation repair or group-local helper is required.

natural_language_analysis.summary: Each return target is an outer Coq disjunction. Choosing its first branch retains every live caller buffer. Result predicates then expose only reflexive return-code equalities and existing resources. The pure target exposes the logical-state status invariant.
